nodes.label: PENDING — Open Items and Watch List
Vercel Deploy — Owner Step Outstanding
nodes.rationale: The dependency half is fixed (postgres and pglite are now direct web/ deps rather than resolving by walking up to the repo-root node_modules), but the project still needs Root Directory = web WITH 'include source files outside the Root Directory' enabled, because the app imports ../../src/**.

nodes.label: FR-34 Cooling-Off Unimplemented; Rails Gate Nothing
nodes.rationale: Investigated while deciding whether to backfill a cooling row. This bears directly on the Phase 2 DoD line 'a simulated rail violation and breaker trip both behave to spec': they behave to spec in tests that call the functions directly, and nothing in the running system calls them. Arguably the Phase 3 blocker, since Phase 3 is the first phase where an unblocked order reaches a broker.

nodes.label: Seven Owner Rails Are Still Constants in Code
nodes.rationale: PRD 11 says all rails live in settings_rails but only cash_ceiling_pct does; four seeded values contradict the PRD, so wiring the rest to the table means fixing those four first — copying the constants across would loosen the employer cap.

nodes.label: FX BLOCKs Every Weekend by Construction
nodes.rationale: FRESHNESS_HOURS.fx is 48h but frankfurter publishes ECB rates on weekdays only, so a normal Fri-to-Mon gap is ~72h: the fetch is fine and the limit is wrong for the publication calendar. Same 'widen the band vs fix the model' call as the digest cron test — do not just raise 48h without deciding which it is.

nodes.label: 10Y G-Sec Yield Has No Ingestion Source
nodes.rationale: The valuation leg scores earnings yield against it, so it is a required caller input; the number is the owner's, not one the engine may invent, and it is not a PRD 15.2 planning constant so it does not belong in ASSUMPTIONS.

nodes.label: Calibration Minimum N = 20 (owner true-up)
nodes.rationale: A stake in the ground, not a derived figure: at 4 recommendations/month it is about half a year of output per conviction bucket, and below it one outcome moves the hit-rate by more than 5 points.

nodes.label: Credit-Rating Actions Have No Source (IPS 3.8)
nodes.rationale: Sell trigger 7 covers maturities only; the standing 3.8 review items cannot be watched automatically, so the owner must choose a manual quarterly review or a rating source in a later phase.

nodes.label: Screener Gate Inputs — Owner Decision
nodes.rationale: Screener has no native column for FCF 5Y or Red Flags. FCF was settled by the owner adding Free Cash Flow 5Yrs to the screen; Red Flags settled as per-company manual review with the gate treating NULL as a NOTE rather than a failure.

nodes.label: Real Fidelity Statement Is the Live Test
nodes.rationale: The next statement screenshot both exercises the shipped RSU flow end to end and resolves the per-grant split true-up, because it carries per-grant units and vest dates — the exact data the gap asks for. Never tune the model toward the PRD value.

nodes.label: Workflow Schedules and Digest-on-Sync Gating
nodes.rationale: digest.yml lost its fixed cron and fires on workflow_run of sync gated on success, with the trade-off accepted that a failed sync means no digest that day; sync moved to 19:00 IST so it runs after NSE publishes the whole-market file around 18:00.
